brief.en: Tap on the nut to fire energies collected from damaged nuts
brief.zh: 点击发射来自受伤坚果的能量

description.en: Mirror-nuts collects energies from other nuts when they're damaged. Click to release the energies.
description.zh: 镜面坚果收集其他坚果受伤时释放的能量，点击以释放这些能量。

chat.en: Mirror-nut dressed up as a mirrorball for a disco-themed party. He never looked back, because that'd get his view blocked by his own outfit.
chat.zh: 镜面坚果穿着一套镜面球参加迪斯科主题派对，从不回头，因为回头会被自己的行头挡住视野。

text.en: when charged and defeated, deals damage to all enemies in the lane
text.zh: 充能并被打败后，对整行敌人造成伤害
